title: Shulchan Arukh Yoreh Deah — Wikisource English 135 (partial)
attribution: Shulchan Arukh by Joseph Karo with Rema glosses; English translations by Wikisource contributors. See source-manifest.json for pinned revisions and contributor histories. CC BY-SA 4.0.
changes: Selected paragraphs from one source revision, removed page navigation and interleaved Hebrew, and escaped text for the reader. Adapted text remains CC BY-SA 4.0.
scope: Selected English translations of Yoreh Deah 135:2–3, 7–8, and 13–16. Section 7 is partial: the English omits that vessels purchased from non-Jews were previously used and uses “pouring” for irui. Section 15 omits a gloss. Other sections are excluded. The selected passages were compared with adjacent Hebrew and the local edition but are not independently proofread; the source revision does not establish translation method.
